Cosa dovreste sapere di noi

Il Gruppo Emil Frey non è solo un'azienda familiare svizzera con 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle aziende leader nel settore automobilistico. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i pilastri dell'azienda. L'attenzione delle attività si concentra sull'importazione di marche automobilistiche, sulla gestione di officine, sulla logistica di ricambi e accessori nonché sulla fornitura di servizi finanziari. Emil Frey AG St. Gallen è partner ufficiale di vendita e assistenza per i marchi Jaguar, Landrover, Toyota, Lexus, Suzuki, Mitsubishi, Subaru e Zeekr e dispone inoltre di una carrozzeria e di un magazzino ricambi.

Compiti
- Esecuzione di lavori di servizio e riparazione secondo le indicazioni del produttore
- Verifica della funzionalità di vari componenti
- Diagnostica con l'aiuto del responsabile dell'officina
- Partecipazione regolare a corsi e formazione specifici per marca

Requisiti
- Formazione professionale completata come meccatronico automobilistico con attestato federale
- Formazione o interesse per la formazione come diagnostico automobilistico è un vantaggio
- Siete autonomi, in grado di lavorare in team e avete una coscienza della qualità
- Buone conoscenze della lingua tedesca, sia scritta che orale
- Patente di guida categoria B

Ciò che offriamo
Trovate presso di noi una nuova sfida con compiti interessanti e molto altro:
- Numerosi vantaggi (auto nuove e usate, lavori di servizio e ricambi, assicurazioni auto e sanitarie, carte di pagamento, hotel e molto altro)
- Una propria cassa pensione attraente come istituzione di previdenza indipendente
- Una prospettiva aziendale a lungo termine
- Possibilità individuali di formazione e sviluppo
- Almeno 25 giorni di ferie

descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us

The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the company's core pillars. The focus of activities is on importing car brands, operating garages, logistics for spare and accessory parts, and providing financial services. Emil Frey AG St. Gallen is the official sales and service partner for the brands Jaguar, Landrover, Toyota, Lexus, Suzuki, Mitsubishi, Subaru, and Zeekr and also has a body shop and a spare parts warehouse.

Tasks
- Performing service and repair work according to the manufacturer's specifications
- Checking the functionality of various components
- Diagnosis with the help of the workshop manager
- Regular participation in brand-specific courses and further training

Requirements
- Completed vocational training as an automotive mechatronics technician with a federal certificate
- Further training or interest in further training as an automotive diagnostic technician is an advantage
- You are independent, able to work in a team, and have a quality awareness
- Good German language skills in writing and speaking
- Driver's license category B

What we offer
You will find a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more at our company:
- Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more)
- An attractive, independent pension fund as a separate pension institution
- A long-term company perspective
- Individual training and development opportunities
- At least 25 days of vacation

Contact
Daniela Bühler, Regional HR Manager, is looking forward to receiving your complete application (including CV, work certificates, etc.) via the "Apply now!" link. For the sake of readability, we refrain from using masculine, feminine, and diverse language forms (m/w/d) simultaneously. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means to us that people work together in teams that achieve the best possible results through their uniqueness and diversity. We are convinced that a diverse workforce and an integrative culture enable us to fully exploit our potential.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Ce que vous devriez savoir sur nous

Le Groupe Emil Frey n'est pas seulement une entreprise familiale suisse avec 100 ans d'expérience, mais également l'une des entreprises leaders dans l'industrie automobile. La qualité, la tradition, l'innovation et l'orientation client sont les piliers de l'entreprise. L'attention des activités se concentre sur l'importation de marques automobiles, la gestion de garages, la logistique de pièces de rechange et d'accessoires ainsi que la fourniture de services financiers. Emil Frey AG St. Gallen est partenaire officiel de vente et de service pour les marques Jaguar, Landrover, Toyota, Lexus, Suzuki, Mitsubishi, Subaru et Zeekr et dispose également d'une carrosserie et d'un entrepôt de pièces de rechange.

Tâches
- Exécution de travaux de service et de réparation selon les indications du fabricant
- Vérification de la fonctionnalité de divers composants
- Diagnostic avec l'aide du responsable de l'atelier
- Participation régulière à des cours et formations spécifiques à la marque

Exigences
- Formation professionnelle achevée en tant que mécatronique automobile avec certificat fédéral
- Formation ou intérêt pour la formation en tant que technicien de diagnostic automobile est un avantage
- Vous êtes autonome, capable de travailler en équipe et avez une conscience de la qualité
- Bonnes connaissances de la langue allemande, à l'écrit et à l'oral
- Permis de conduire catégorie B

Ce que nous offrons
Vous trouverez chez nous un nouveau défi avec des tâches passionnantes et bien plus encore :
- Nombreux avantages (voitures neuves et d'occasion, travaux de service et pièces de rechange, assurances auto et santé, cartes de paiement, hôtels et bien plus encore)
- Une caisse de pension attractive en tant qu'institution de prévoyance indépendante
- Une perspective d'entreprise à long terme
- Possibilités individuelles de formation et de développement
- Au moins 25 jours de congé

Contact
Daniela Bühler, Responsable régionale du personnel, se réjouit de recevoir votre candidature complète (y compris CV, certificats de travail, etc.) via le lien « Postuler maintenant ! ». Pour des raisons de lisibilité, nous n'utilisons pas simultanément les formes linguistiques masculine, féminine et diverse (m/w/d). Les identités de genre féminines et autres sont explicitement incluses. La diversité signifie pour nous que les personnes travaillent ensemble en équipes qui, grâce à leur unicité et leur diversité, atteignent les meilleurs résultats possibles. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main-d'œuvre diversifiée et une culture intégrative nous permettent d'exploiter pleinement notre potentiel.

descriptionByLocale.it:
## Emil Frey Gruppe La Emil Frey Gruppe non è solo un'azienda familiare svizzera con 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle principali aziende del settore automobilistico. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i pilastri dell'azienda. Le attività si concentrano sull'importazione di marche automobilistiche, l'esercizio di garage, la logistica di parti di ricambio e accessori, nonché la fornitura di servizi finanziari. Con 19 marche mondiali sotto un unico tetto, l'Emil Frey AG Autocenter Safenwil dispone della più ampia gamma di marche nel centro della Svizzera. ### Descrizione - Diagnosi e riparazioni di sistemi elettronici, meccanici, idraulici e pneumatici del veicolo - Esecuzione di riparazioni, conversioni e sostituzioni complesse - Esecuzione di lavori di servizio e manutenzione - Preparazione di MFK - Fornitura tecnica di veicoli nuovi e di seconda mano - Inserimento di accessori - Formazione pratica per allievi di tecnica automobilistica ###
• Requisiti - Laurea conclusa con successo come meccanico automobilistico/mechatronico - Laurea in corso o già conclusa come diagnostico automobilistico - Lavoro autonomo e meticoloso - Approccio efficiente e strutturato - Personalità responsabile, team-oriented e comunicativa - Lingua madre tedesca o conoscenze tedesche molto buone in parole e scrittura ###
• Cosa offriamo - Troverai una nuova sfida con compiti interessanti e molto altro: - Numerose agevolazioni (veicoli nuovi e di seconda mano, lavori di servizio e parti di ricambio, assicurazioni di veicoli e malattia, carte di carburante, alberghi e molto altro) - Una propria, attraente cassa di pensione come ente di previdenza indipendente - Una prospettiva di impiego a lungo termine - Possibilità di formazione e sviluppo individuali - Almeno 25 giorni di ferie - Posto di parcheggio gratuito - Ristorante personale ### Contatto Melanie Achini, Responsabile locale del personale, si compiacerà della tua candidatura completa (ad esempio, curriculum, attestati di lavoro, ecc.) via il link "Candidati ora!". Per motivi di leggibilità, si è deciso di non utilizzare contemporaneamente le forme grammaticali maschile, femminile e diverso (m/w/d). Le identità di genere femminile e altre vengono esplicitamente incluse. La diversità significa che le persone lavorano in team che, grazie alla loro unicità e diversità, raggiungono i risultati migliori. Siamo convinti che una squadra di lavoro diversificata e una cultura integrativa ci permettano di sfruttare al meglio le nostre potenzialità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Emil Frey Group The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience but also one of the leading companies in the automotive sector. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the company's pillars. The activities focus on importing automotive brands, operating garages, logistics for spare parts and accessories, as well as providing financial services. With 19 global brands under one roof, Emil Frey AG Autocenter Safenwil offers the widest range of brands in the heart of Switzerland. Description - Diagnosis and repair of electronic, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic vehicle systems - Execution of complex repairs, conversions, and replacements - Performance of service and maintenance work - Preparation of MFK - Technical preparation of new and used vehicles - Installation of accessories - Practical training for automotive technology students
• Requirements - Successfully completed degree as an automotive mechanic/mechatronics engineer - Ongoing or already completed degree as an automotive diagnostic technician - Independent and meticulous work - Efficient and structured approach - Responsible, team-oriented, and communicative personality - Native German speaker or very good German language skills in speaking and writing What We Offer - You will find a new challenge with interesting tasks and much more: - Numerous benefits (new and used vehicles, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more) - An attractive, independent pension fund - A long-term employment prospect - Opportunities for individual training and development - At least 25 days of vacation - Free parking - Personal restaurant Contact Melanie Achini, Local HR Manager, will be pleased to receive your complete application (e.g., resume, work certificates, etc.) via the "Apply now!" link. For readability reasons, we have decided not to use masculine, feminine, and diverse grammatical forms (m/w/d) simultaneously. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means that people work in teams that achieve the best results thanks to their uniqueness and diversity. We are convinced that a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture enable us to fully exploit our potential.

Siamo convinti che una squadra di lavoro variegata e una cultura integrativa ci permettano di sfruttare al meglio le nostre potenzialità.

• What we offer - Numerous benefits (new and used vehicles, maintenance and repair work, spare parts, vehicle and illness insurance, fuel cards, hotels and more) - An attractive old-age pension as an independent pension fund - A long-term career perspective - Possibility of individual training and development - Minimum 25 days of vacation Contact Chiara Staccioli, Regional Personnel Manager, will be pleased to receive your complete application (e.g. curriculum, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. Activities focus on importing automotive brands, operating garages, logistics of spare parts and accessories, as well as providing financial services. The Autocenter Bern of Emil Frey AG represents 11 global brands under one roof. The facility includes our body shops, our paint shop, and a spare parts warehouse with highly qualified and specialized personnel.
• Responsibilities - Repairing body damage on step-through vehicles and light vehicles - Executing orientation, traction, and compression work on vehicle bodies - Disassembling and assembling vehicle parts - Applying welding and assembly techniques - Repairing and replacing damaged vehicle parts - Preparing vehicles for painting - Ensuring compliance with quality and safety standards
• Requirements - Completed degree as Carrosserie Pengler EFZ - Advantageous work experience, also motivated and in-training candidates accepted - Precise, clean, and autonomous work - Understands technical language and has good spatial representation skills - Autonomous, reliable, and able to work in a team - Category B driving license - Our friendly and open team is expecting you
• What we offer - You will find a new challenge with interesting tasks and much more: - Numerous benefits (new and used vehicles, service work and spare parts, vehicle and illness insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more) - Your own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund - A long-term perspective for the company - Opportunities for individual training and development - At least 25 days of vacation Contact Klaudia Dushaj, personnel employee, is expecting the complete application (e.g., curriculum, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!".

What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family-owned company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation, and customer orientation are the pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare parts and accessories, as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey AG Biel is the official sales and/or service partner of the brands Subaru, Jaguar / Land Rover, Toyota, Kia, and Suzuki. We are looking for reinforcement for our team in Biel as of May 1, 2026 or by agreement. Your tasks
• You take care of the success-oriented and active sales of our broad model palette
• From the first contact, you care for our customers, advise them on the vehicle selection and the various financing and insurance options
• You ensure the successful delivery of the vehicle and the follow-up contact (especially customer satisfaction)
• The daily care of your existing customer base and the acquisition of new customers are part of your tasks, as well as the management and care of the vehicle park
• The care of our online appearance of the vehicles (announcement, photos, etc.)
• The help with events/exhibitions and the close cooperation with our departments (workshop, spare parts warehouse and customer service) is assumed Your profile
• Sales and consulting are fun for you
• You are a sales-oriented and strong negotiating personality and have already gained experience in sales and in the automotive industry (advantage)
• Your commercial flair, your customer and service orientation, and your communicative strength characterize you
• A high level of personal motivation, assertiveness, and passion for cars complete your profile
• You are fascinated by new technologies, trends, and IT and have a high level of flexibility and willingness to learn
• You speak at least two languages (DE and FR) and hold a category B driving license
• Your positive attitude enables you to easily integrate into a motivated and open team What we offer you
• You will find a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous benefits (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels, and much more)
• Your own attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term corporate perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of vacation How to contact us Stefan Lanz, Administration Manager, looks forward to your complete application (e.g., curriculum vitae, work certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For better readability, we have decided not to use the form of gender male, female, and diverse (m/w/d). Women and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity means that people work together in teams that, thanks to their uniqueness and diversity, achieve the best results. We are convinced that a diverse workforce and an integrative culture enable us to fully exploit our potential.

• Erfolgsorientierter Verkauf: Sie übernehmen die Verantwortung für den Verkauf von Neuwagen und Occasionen der innovativen Marke KIA
• Kundenberatung: Sie bieten eine kundenorientierte, umfassende Beratung und stellen eine konsequente, professionelle Betreuung von bestehenden sowie neuen Kunden sicher

• Events: Sie arbeiten aktiv bei Ausstellungen und spannenden Kundenanlässen mit
• Verkaufserfahrung: Sie bringen zwingend mindestens zwei bis drei Jahre erfolgreiche Verkaufserfahrung mit, idealerweise in der Automobilbranche oder im Dienstleistungssektor
• Automobile Leidenschaft: Sie besitzen eine grosse Begeisterung für die Automobilbranche und brennen für den Autoverkauf
• Gewinnende Persönlichkeit: Der Kundenkontakt ist Ihre absolute Stärke. Sie überzeugen durch ein souveränes, gepflegtes Auftreten sowie ein ausgeprägtes Verkaufsflair
• Dienstleistungsmentalität: Eine starke Kundenorientierung, hoher Servicegedanke und Verhandlungsgeschick zeichnen Sie aus
• Flexibilität: Sie sind belastbar, lernbereit und bringen die Bereitschaft mit, am Samstag zu arbeiten
• Sprachkompetenz: Sie kommunizieren stilsicher in Deutsch und besitzen gute Englischkenntnisse. Weitere Fremdsprachen wie Französisch oder Italienisch sind ein grosses Plus
• Erfolgswille: Sie besitzen ein echtes Winner Mindset mit Fokus auf Zielerreichung und eine hohe Eigeninitiative
• Mobilität : Sie sind im Besitz eines gültigen Führerausweises der Kategorie B

• Du hast Freude an Autos und konntest vorteilsweise bereits erste Berufserfahrungen sammeln.
• Ausserdem verfügst du über eine gute Auffassungsgabe sowie eine exakte und gründliche Arbeitsweise.

• Als flexiblen Mitarbeitenden kommt dir unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten entgegen.

Mehr erfährst du auch auf unserer Website www.hertzcareer.ch. Was wir Dir bieten Du findest bei uns eine neue Herausforderung mit spannenden Aufgaben und vielem mehr:
• Zahlreiche Vergünstigungen (Neu- und Gebrauchtwagen, Servicearbeiten und Ersatzteile, Fahrzeug- und Krankenversicherungen, Tankkarten, Hotels und vieles mehr)
• Eine eigene, attraktive Pensionskasse als unabhängige Vorsorgeeinrichtung
• Eine langfristige Unternehmensperspektive
• Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungs-Möglichkeiten

Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i pilastri principali dell'azienda. Il focus delle attività è sull'importazione di marchi di auto, il funzionamento di garage, la logistica di ricambio e accessori e la fornitura di servizi finanziari. Herold Fahrzeugvermietung AG è il licenziatario di Hertz per il mercato svizzero. Hertz è uno dei marchi più famosi al mondo e si trova a livello globale per un'eccellente offerta di noleggio auto. In qualità di autista, consegnate i nostri veicoli noleggiati ai clienti o prendete i trasferimenti all'interno della regione di Zurigo tra le stazioni di noleggio di Hertz. Puoi anche saperne di più sul nostro sito www.hertzcareer.ch. Il tuo profilo
• Hai la patente di guida definitiva Kat. B
• Hai un record criminale perfetto e un estratto di IVZ (ADMAS)
• Vivi nella regione di Zurigo e puoi raggiungere la stazione di noleggio Hertz nell'Hardturm o nella Stazione Centrale di Zurigo con i mezzi pubblici al massimo. 20-30 minuti
• come piloti, in particolare i pensionati sono benvenuti, in quanto questa attività non porta un carico di lavoro garantito (su richiesta) La reciproca flessibilità, la possibilità di muoversi in modo diverso, anche gli ultimi modelli di veicoli e il buon spirito di squadra caratterizzano la posizione di pilota presso Hertz Svizzera. Hertz Svizzera coltiva una cultura collegiale e unisce diverse nazioni e culture in azienda. A Hertz Svizzera, si beneficiano di vantaggi sociali molto buoni e interessanti sconti sui noleggio di veicoli sia in patria che all'estero. Un team esperto ti supporta nella fase di allenamento. I nostri dipendenti sono il fattore di successo più importante, motivo per cui offriamo loro l'opportunità di sviluppare ulteriormente. Come potete contattarci Il reparto risorse umane non vede l'ora di completare l'applicazione (ad esempio CV, certificati di lavoro, ecc.) tramite il link "Applica ora!". Per motivi di migliore leggibilità, l'uso simultaneo delle forme di lingua maschile, femminile e diverso (m/f/d) è rinunciato. Le identità femminili e di altro genere sono esplicitamente incluse. Per noi, la diversità significa anche che le persone lavorano insieme in team che ottengono i migliori risultati possibili attraverso la loro unicità e diversità. Crediamo che una forza lavoro diversificata e una cultura inclusiva ci permettano di realizzare il nostro pieno potenziale. Mostra video Acconsento che i contenuti esterni mi vengono mostrati. Questo trasferisce i dati personali a piattaforme di terze parti. Emil Frey AG non ha alcuna influenza su questo. Potete saperne di più su questo nella nostra dichiarazione di protezione dei dati. descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the main pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessories as well as the provision of financial services. Herold Fahrzeugvermietung AG is the licensee of Hertz for the Swiss market. Hertz is one of the most famous brands in the world and stands globally for an excellent car rental offer. As a driver, you deliver our rented vehicles to customers or take over transfers within the Zurich region between Hertz rental stations. You can also find out more on our website www.hertzcareer.ch. Your profile
• You have the definitive driving license Kat. B
• You have a perfect criminal record and IVZ extract (ADMAS)
• You live in the Zurich region and can reach the Hertz rental station in the Hardturm or the Zurich Central Station with public transport within max. 20-30 minutes
• as drivers, especially pensioners are welcome, as this activity does not bring a guaranteed workload (on demand) The mutual flexibility, the possibility to move different, even the latest vehicle models and the good team spirit characterize the position as a driver at Hertz Switzerland. Hertz Switzerland cultivates a collegial du-culture and unites different nations and cultures in the company. At Hertz Switzerland, you benefit from very good social benefits and attractive discounts on vehicle rentals both at home and abroad. An experienced team supports you in the training phase. Our employees are the most important success factor, which is why we offer them the opportunity to develop further. How you can contact us The HR department is looking forward to the complete application (e.g. CV, employment certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For reasons of better legibility, the simultaneous use of the language forms male, female and diverse (m/f/d) is waived. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. For us, diversity also means that people work together in teams that achieve the best possible results through their uniqueness and diversity. We believe that a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture allow us to realize our full potential. Editorially recommended external content Show video I agree that external content is shown to me. This transfers personal data to third-party platforms. Emil Frey AG has no influence on this. You can read more about this in our data protection declaration. You can deactivate the display at any time. You can deactivate such external embeddings with this switch (data protection declaration). As a driver, you deliver our rented vehicles to customers or take over transfers within the Zurich region between Hertz rental stations. You can also find out more on our website www.hertzcareer.ch.
• You have the definitive driving license Kat. B
• You have a perfect criminal record and IVZ extract (ADMAS)
• You live in the Zurich region and can reach the Hertz rental station in the Hardturm or the Zurich Central Station with public transport within max. 20-30 minutes
• as drivers, especially pensioners are welcome, as this activity does not bring a guaranteed workload (on demand)
descriptionByLocale.de:
Was Du über uns wissen solltest Die Emil Frey Gruppe ist nicht nur ein Schweizer Familienunternehmen mit 100 Jahren Erfahrung, sondern auch eine der führenden Firmen der Automobilbranche. Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die tragenden Pfeiler des Unternehmens. Dabei liegt der Fokus der Aktivitäten auf dem Import von Automarken, dem Betrieb von Garagen, der Logistik von Ersatz- und Zubehörteilen sowie der Erbringung von Finanzdienstleistungen. Die Herold Fahrzeugvermietung AG ist der Lizenznehmer von Hertz für den Schweizer Markt. Hertz gehört zu den bekanntesten Marken der Welt und steht global für ein exzellentes Mietwagenangebot. Deine Aufgaben Du lieferst als Fahrer unsere vermieteten Fahrzeuge an Kunden aus oder übernimmst Transfers innerhalb der Region Zürich zwischen Hertz Vermietstationen. Mehr erfährst du auch auf unserer Website www.hertzcareer.ch. Dein Profil
• du besitzt den definitiven Führerschein Kat. B
• du verfügst über einen einwandfreien Strafregister- und IVZ-Auszug (ADMAS)
• du wohnst in der Region Zürich und erreichst die Hertz Vermietstation im Hardturm oder den Hauptbahnhof Zürich mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel innert max. 20-30 Minuten
• als Fahrer sind vor allem Rentner herzlich willkommen, da diese Tätigkeit kein garantiertes Arbeitspensum (auf Abruf) mitsichbringt Was wir Dir bieten Die beidseitige Flexibilität, die Möglichkeit verschiedene, auch neuste Fahrzeugmodelle zu bewegen und der gute Teamspirit zeichnen die Stelle als Fahrerin und Fahrer bei Hertz Schweiz aus. Hertz Schweiz pflegt eine kollegiale Du-Kultur und vereint im Unternehmen verschiedene Nationen und Kulturen. Du profitierst bei Hertz Schweiz von sehr guten Sozialleistungen und attraktiven Rabatten auf Fahrzeugmieten sowohl im In- als auch im Ausland. Ein erfahrenes Team unterstützt Dich in der Einarbeitungsphase. Unsere Mitarbeitende sind der wichtigste Erfolgsfaktor, weshalb wir ihnen die Möglichkeit bieten, sich weiterzuentwickeln. Wie Du uns kontaktieren kannst Die Personalabteilung freut sich auf die vollständige Bewerbung (u.a. Lebenslauf, Arbeitszeugnisse, etc.) via des Links "Jetzt bewerben!". Aus Gründen der besseren Lesbarkeit wird auf die gleichzeitige Verwendung der Sprachformen männlich, weiblich und divers (m/w/d) verzichtet. Weibliche und anderweitige Geschlechteridentitäten werden dabei ausdrücklich mitgemeint. Diversität bedeutet für uns auch, dass Menschen in Teams zusammenarbeiten, die durch ihre Einzigartigkeit und Unterschiedlichkeit die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse erzielen. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass eine vielfältige Belegschaft, sowie eine integrative Kultur es uns ermöglichen, unser volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen. Was Sie über uns wissen sollten Die Emil Frey Gruppe ist nicht nur ein Schweizer Familienunternehmen mit über 100 Jahren Erfahrung, sondern auch eine der führenden Firmen der Automobilbranche. Qualität, Tradition, Innovation und Kundenorientierung sind die tragenden Pfeiler des Unternehmens. Dabei liegt der Fokus der Aktivitäten auf dem Import von Automarken, dem Betrieb von Garagen, der Logistik von Ersatz- und Zubehörteilen sowie der Erbringung von Finanzdienstleistungen. Die Emil Frey Betriebs AG erbringt Logistikdienstleistungen für Waren und Fahrzeuge und ist somit die Drehscheibe im Warenfluss zwischen unseren Kunden und deren Endverbraucher. Ihre Aufgaben

• Allgemeine Unterstützung und Aushilfe im Bereich Carrosserie

Lebenslauf, Arbeitszeugnisse, etc.) via des Links "Jetzt bewerben!". descriptionByLocale.it:
L'Emil Frey Group non è solo una famiglia svizzera con oltre 100 anni di esperienza, ma anche una delle aziende leader nel settore automotive. Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i principali pilastri dell'azienda. Il focus delle attività è sull'importazione di marchi di auto, il funzionamento di garage, la logistica di ricambio e accessori, nonché la fornitura di servizi finanziari. descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family company with over 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the main pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessories as well as the provision of financial services. Emil Frey Betriebs AG provides logistics services for goods and vehicles and is thus the hub in the flow of goods between our customers and their end users. Their tasks
• Completion of all necessary finishing and preparation work on new and occupation vehicles of all brands
• Preparation of EC2 condition reports and careful documentation of vehicle condition
• Detection and assessment of optical defects and determination of the necessary treatment measures
• Performing easy decor work
• General support and assistance in the field of Carrosserie
• Ensuring a high quality of work and a well-kept appearance of the vehicles Your profile
• Completed vocational apprenticeship, beneficial in an artisanal or automotive field
• Professional experience in a similar position in the field of finishing or vehicle preparation
• Experience or interest in assessing and documenting vehicle conditions
• Very good understanding of vehicles and their surfaces
• Strong eye for detail and high quality awareness
• Good knowledge of German in words and writing
• Self-employed, reliable and careful work
• Flexibility and high service orientation
• Joy of varied tasks and cooperation in the team What we offer you You will find a new challenge with us with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous discounts (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and much more)
• An own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension fund
• A long-term business perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of holiday As you can contact us Andrea Lugonjic, Head of Staff, is looking forward to the complete application (e.g. CV, employment certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For reasons of better readability, the simultaneous use of the language forms male, female and diverse (m/f/d) is waived. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity also means for us that people work together in teams that achieve the best possible results through their uniqueness and diversity. We believe that a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture enable us to realize our full potential.

• Performing easy decor work

• Ensuring a high quality of work and a well-kept appearance of the vehicles
• Completed vocational apprenticeship, beneficial in an artisanal or automotive field
• Professional experience in a similar position in the field of finishing or vehicle preparation
• Experience or interest in assessing and documenting vehicle conditions

• Strong eye for detail and high quality awareness
• Good knowledge of German in words and writing
• Self-employed, reliable and careful work
• Flexibility and high service orientation
• Enjoying varied tasks and working together in a team

• Ricevimento delle merci: esecuzione dell'accettazione delle merci, dei controlli di ricezione e delle prenotazioni di sistema
• Trasporti interni: gestione del magazzino, raccolta di merci e fornitura di materiali di montaggio
• Qualità e sicurezza: conformità ai requisiti di qualità, pulizia sul posto di lavoro e documentazione delle sequenze di processo
• Funzionamento dell'impianto: monitoraggio delle linee di trasporto automatiche, stoccaggio scaffali e apparecchiature di controllo
• Risoluzione dei problemi: rilevamento precoce e correzione rapida dei difetti tecnici o delle confetture dei materiali
• Manutenzione: Assistenza con servizio regolare, manutenzione e lavori di riparazione minori. Il tuo profilo
• Formazione completa come operatore di impianti (o prassi equivalente)

• Processing of contract changes such as rewrites and renewals
• Telephone & written advice for dealers, partners and end customers

• You have a completed commercial education. Ideally, with experience in finance or mobility.
• You bring professional experience in the application examination or in leasing / credit.
• Legal requirements such as the GWG and KKG are familiar to you and you can assess credit ratings.
• Dealing with contract documents as well as digital CRM and financing systems is easy for you.
• You work structured, think analytically and keep track even under time pressure.
• You communicate clearly and professionally. In German stylish, in French very good, Italian is a plus.
• You are customer-oriented, capable of teamwork and bring the willingness to continuously develop professionally. In addition to the opportunity to shape the future of mobility and to realize auto dreams, we offer further benefits:
• As a family-run company, we value long-term relationships and sustainable growth.
• The opportunity to actively shape the expansion and orientation of Emil Frey Mobility AG with your ideas.
• With us you can expect a positive working environment based on team spirit and respect.
